The article does not examine whether a cookie banner is needed "at all", but rather how to make that decision based on the site's actual config. The focus is on infrastructure: which scripts and external services are actually loaded, what requires consent, what is permissible without a banner, and why the universal formula "no banner = non-compliance" is technically incorrect.

This is useful for those responsible for small business websites, privacy-first architecture, and auditing external dependencies: https://example.com
